title: The writ's hollow-count is stated differently by every source that mentions it: Herald Corvane says 'Burn two' at the very start, the status screen's road summary always says '(a hollow burned, or two services to Highward's Watch)' (implying one), and Highward's Captain-General separately says 'Burn a hollow, or serve this Watch twice over' (also implying one) — only Aldous's second statement and the actual quest trigger agree on two.
where: Last Light Square (Herald Corvane) / status road summary / Highward Captain-General's Hall
